title: Startup Resolution Audit Reconciliation

evidence.claim: Startup now reconciles transaction resolution history into the global recovery ledger before pending transaction replay and final health authorization.
Crash-gap audit repair and repeated-startup idempotence are covered by regression tests.
TransactionJournal.mirror_resolution_events provides deterministic idempotent reconciliation from durable resolution history.
RecoveryEventLedger rejects conflicting duplicate event identities and treats identical deterministic events as idempotent.

remaining_backlog: Source Registry and Signal Store default startup health wiring
blockers: Current branch-head CI result is pending.
